notes: Act 46 (SLH 2024): tax year 2026 brackets are the same as 2025 and the standard deduction rises to $8,000 single / $16,000 joint / $12,000 head of household (DOTAX Announcement 2024-03).
Act 24 (SLH 2026) lowers the 2nd/3rd bracket rates and adds a 13% top bracket only from tax year 2027 (DOTAX Announcement 2026-06); 2026 is unaffected.
Personal exemption $1,144 per exemption (taxpayer and spouse modeled; dependents not). Hawaii did not adopt the federal suspension of personal exemptions.

Not modeled: Hawaii's alternative 7.25% maximum rate on net capital gains, itemized deduction rules, refundable food/excise and other credits, the pension exclusion and other Hawaii adjustments to federal AGI.
Hawaii General Excise Tax (GET) on gross receipts (see businessCosts) is a major extra cost for Hawaii freelancers and is not part of the income tax calculation.

seDeduction.note: Inherited: Form N-11 starts from federal AGI, which reflects the deductible half of SE tax.

retirementContributions.note: SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) deductions are inherited through federal AGI.

qbi.note: The federal QBI deduction is below AGI; Hawaii computes taxable income from federal AGI with its own deductions, so no QBI deduction applies.

localIncomeTax.note: Hawaii counties do not levy income taxes. All four counties add a 0.5% surcharge to the 4% General Excise Tax (gross receipts), which is not an income tax.

estimatedTax.threshold: Required if you expect to owe at least $500 for the year after withholding and credits, and withholding/credits will be less than the smaller of 60% of current-year tax or 100% of prior-year tax.
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: Pay the smaller of 60% of the current-year tax or 100% of the prior-year tax (prior year must be a full 12-month return). No estimate needed if expected liability after withholding is under $500. Due dates are as printed by DOTAX; a date falling on a weekend moves to the next business day.
estimatedTax.form: Form N-200V (Individual Income Tax Payment Voucher)

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $50 Articles of Organization (domestic LLC), plus optional $25 expedited review.
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None for an LLC or sole proprietor.
businessCosts.grossReceiptsTax: General Excise Tax 4% of gross receipts from services, plus 0.5% county surcharge in Honolulu, Hawaii, Kauai and Maui counties (4.5% total; max pass-on rate 4.712%). No small-business threshold; GET license is a one-time $20 fee. Periodic returns due the 20th of the month after the period.
